title: Innokin Sceptre Replacement Pod [2ml]
description: Legendary vape innovators Innokin continue their foray into the world of beginner-friendly pod kits with the exceptional Innokin Sceptre kit. Designed for the Innokin Sceptre Pod kit, these empty refillable pods are hold 2ml of your favourite e-liquids and are compatible with the Innokin Sceptre coils which offer a resistance range between 0.5 ohm to 1.2 ohm. The 2ml Sceptre pods are easy to fill and are ideal for use with high-PG , 50/50 and Nic salt e-liquids. The pods feature a side refill port and an ergonomic drip tip as well as an adjustable airflow.
